idea-plugin.name: WTT-CommonLib Template Menu
idea-plugin.description:
A productivity plugin designed for WTT-CommonLib development that streamlines inserting JSON templates into existing files for custom game content.

Features

  • Quick Template Insertion: Insert pre-structured JSON templates for custom items, clothing, and other game assets with a single click
  • Context Menu Integration: Access template insertion directly from the editor's right-click menu while editing files
  • Seamless Workflow: Reduces boilerplate code writing and ensures a consistent template structure across your project

This plugin is specifically designed to work with the WTT-CommonLib framework from WTT's GrooveyPenguinX, providing developers with efficient tools to speed up custom content development.

group.description: Insert a JSON template into the current editor
